title: Vanguard Natural Resources, Inc. Successfully Completes Financial Restructuring
主要内容: Vanguard Natural Resources, Inc. successfully completed its financial restructuring and emerged from Chapter 11 as Grizzly Energy, LLC. The restructuring eliminated over $500 million in secured debt and enhanced financial flexibility. The company entered into a $65 million reserve-based revolving credit facility, a $65 million first lien term loan A facility, and a $285 million "last out" first lien term loan B facility. The initial borrowing base under the revolving credit facility was set at $65 million, with a redetermination scheduled for April 2020. The company reported its reserves as of June 30, 2019, with total estimated proved reserves of 1,044 Bcfe, of which approximately 64% were natural gas reserves, 20% were oil reserves, and 16% were NGLs reserves. 91% of the reserves were proved developed, with an average ten-year proved developed decline rate of 9%. The total estimated reserve PV-10 value was $967 million, using June 30, 2019 SEC commodity pricing. Capital expenditures for the first half of 2019 were approximately $22 million.
